primarySources.supports: OpenFile passes manager-opened descriptors; read-only must be explicit. Missing files must not use graceful suppression.
The reference READ_ONLY flag is 1; append/truncate/graceful are separate flags.
Reference implementation opens the path and reopens non-socket descriptors using access flags. This is not a VPS descriptor-transfer test.
Named descriptors use LISTEN_PID/LISTEN_FDS/LISTEN_FDNAMES and start at descriptor 3. These environment fields alone are not authentication.
An O_RDONLY directory can be a dirfd for openat; read-only directory descriptors do not by themselves confine relative-path access or child writes.

Controllers are hierarchical, memory.current includes descendants, and cgroup.events populated is recursive. These facts are not proof that every descendant was enumerated or that all final counters were collected.

approaches.recommendation: Preferred bounded local feasibility path, not yet an approved or complete observer implementation.
approaches.advantages: No broad host-directory or control-socket handoff; existing root reader stays intact.
approaches.limitations: Needs independent descriptor provenance, separate observer identity, and a remaining subtree/finalization proof.

approaches.recommendation: Do not choose as a shortcut.
approaches.advantages: Could preserve the existing host-view reader assumptions.
approaches.limitations: Requires a separately verified write/network sandbox and truthful shared-budget accounting; root read-only behavior alone is insufficient.
Would weaken existing guarantees and incorrectly promote a different reader to native evidence.

recommendedLocalPilot.descriptorScope: Finite exact-named regular-file descriptors only; no directory, socket, device or FIFO descriptors.
recommendedLocalPilot.provenance: Bind nonce, source digest, unit/cgroup identity and an independent host-side metadata catalog. Validate descriptor names/count, LISTEN_PID, access flags, file type, ownership and device/inode identity before reading; environment labels and matching bytes alone are insufficient.
recommendedLocalPilot.aliasBoundary: Manager opening follows a pathname; independent no-follow host resolution and before/after alias checks are still required. A detached FD alone cannot prove that the current pathname remains the same.
recommendedLocalPilot.observerIdentity: Must not silently reuse the untrusted business identity. Prefer an already-existing separately verified low-privilege identity; no user creation, credential changes or automatic UID fallback.
recommendedLocalPilot.businessIdentityUnchanged: UID996/GID987 and zero capabilities remain the business-process policy.
recommendedLocalPilot.observerCapabilities: Effective/permitted/inheritable/ambient capabilities zero, NoNewPrivileges enabled, no added SYS_PTRACE or SYS_ADMIN.
recommendedLocalPilot.fdHandling: Set close-on-exec, do not hand descriptors to models or business processes, bound reads, reject drift/overflow/missing FD/unsupported seek behavior, preserve primary and cleanup errors.
recommendedLocalPilot.guaranteeScope: The first pilot verifies only a finite delivered-FD contract. O_RDONLY, capability removal and NNP do not by themselves prohibit all filesystem writes or networking.
recommendedLocalPilot.identityPrerequisites: Verify supplementary groups and same-UID process trust as well as the primary UID. Distinct numeric UIDs alone are not a complete process-isolation proof.
recommendedLocalPilot.catalogAuthority: Use an independently source-pinned supervisor and a receiver-bound one-shot channel; bind the independently expected InvocationID, process birth identity, nonce, source digests and bounded alias-check window. Caller JSON, FD names and LISTEN_* are not a trusted issuer. Do not introduce or repurpose credential secrets as a shortcut.
recommendedLocalPilot.inheritedDescriptorInventory: Check the actual inherited set, not only LISTEN_* counts. Define stdio and other necessary IO separately; regular-file-only applies to the delivered data payload, not an assumption that stdout or stdin are regular files. Do not close unowned descriptors as cleanup.
recommendedLocalPilot.flagDistinction: OpenFile READ_ONLY=1 is the manager property flag, not the OS access-mode value. Check the received descriptor access mode against O_RDONLY, reject O_PATH, and set FD_CLOEXEC after taking ownership rather than assuming it is already set on an inherited descriptor.
recommendedLocalPilot.noBlockingDeadlineClaim: Bounded byte counts alone do not interrupt a blocking syscall. Native use still needs the independently enforced shared hard deadline and owned-process cleanup.

unresolvedProductionGates: A complete source-bound descriptor transfer under actual systemd and intended low-privilege identity has not been tested.
Cgroup files must exist before OpenFile activation; launch ordering cannot ignore missing files or omit worker startup costs.
Kernel hierarchy accounting cannot silently replace a required full descendant census; keep any missing census requirement unverified.
Observer and workload must be under the same applied aggregate limits. Any admission/finalization outside that boundary must be explicit and cannot be passed off as measured aggregate cost.
The finalizer cannot prove its own whole-parent emptiness while still running inside it; terminal ownership, retained cgroup counters and finalizer accounting need a separate design and test.
Open FDs may become unreadable after cgroup removal; missing or retired counters must fail, not become zero.
Service-snapshot stability is not an application, Relay traffic, real-model or publication acceptance result.

Aggregate hard limits do not reserve observer headroom. Before combined execution, establish a measured admission/headroom policy without silently changing worker limits or treating an OOM-killed observer as successful.
